title: Data-Driven Emerging Manager Investing
primary_theme: Data-driven emerging manager investing as a consistent asset allocation discipline
secondary_themes: Fund one and emerging manager access
founder_lessons: Work with investors who are built to stay consistently engaged across market cycles, not just when venture is hot.
Diversified early-stage funds can support founders by improving the odds that the firm itself becomes enduring.
Reference-check investors for responsiveness and useful help rather than relying on ownership percentage or narrative.
Investor help should be humble, available, and founder-pulled rather than micromanaging or overconfident.
